title: Navan Edge vs. Muse: Which is better for booking business trips?
summary: Compare Navan Edge, a dedicated business-travel AI agent, with Muse, Meta’s general agent, across booking, loyalty, human help, platforms, and pricing.
body_markdown:
Muse is Meta’s general-purpose personal AI agent. It can help with email, calendars, shopping, forms, web browsing, and other everyday tasks. Travel is one of those jobs: Muse can book flights through a Duffel integration and use its browser or connectors for other parts of a trip.


Navan Edge is an AI travel agent built specifically for individual business travel. It’s powered by an agentic AI engine and a team of human travel experts 24/7. You can book your entire work trip in one conversation, arranging flights, hotels and restaurants. The agent recognizes your preference and remembers them for future suggestions.


If you’re weighing which AI can best support your work trips, this guide compares Navan Edge and Muse across booking, loyalty, trip changes, human help, access, and pricing. You’ll see how each one fits into the travel process and which experience is likely to suit the way you work.


### Key takeaways


- Navan Edge is the stronger fit when you travel frequently for work and want a platform that remembers your flight, hotel, and restaurant preferences.
- Muse is the stronger fit when you want travel inside a broader personal assistant that also works across email, calendars, shopping, forms, and other daily tasks.
- Both can support bookings. Navan Edge handles flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations for a work trip in one conversation. Muse combines a live Duffel flight integration with browser and connector-based actions for other parts of a trip.
- The Navan Edge loyalty Wallet keeps all your points and status’ visible and can suggest hotels and flights that help you earn more


## What is the main difference between Navan Edge and Muse?


Let’s take a look at the capabilities of both Navan Edge and Muse and how they handle the different aspects of your business trips in practice.


**Navan Edge**


**Muse from Meta**


Core function


Dedicated assistant for individual business travel


General-purpose personal agent. Travel is one of many tasks


Flights


Searches and books flights from real-time travel inventory


Searches and books live flight inventory through Duffel


Hotels


Searches and books hotels in the travel conversation, with very specific traveler preferences


In a hands-on test, Skift found that Muse used its browser to search consumer travel sites for hotel options.


Restaurants


Books restaurant reservations


Can research and make restaurant reservations with approval through its broader action flow


Rewards and loyalty


Eligible hotel bookings can earn Amazon Gift Card rewards. Loyalty Wallet shows supported points, miles, and status progress in one place, and Navan Edge can use that information to shape recommendations.


As of October 6, 2026, Muse’s current public product information lists no dedicated travel-rewards program or loyalty dashboard.


Trip changes


Manages itinerary requests and asks for confirmation before booking, changing, or canceling


The Duffel flight integration supports cancellations and disruption handling; Muse returns for approval when an action requires it


Human travel help


Navan travel agents are available 24/7 and can enter the same conversation thread with full context


Duffel provides 24/7 travel-expert support for its Muse flight integration


Price


Free


As of October 6, 2026, most use is free; paid subscription plans are also available


Target user


A frequent traveler who wants one continuing relationship around recurring work trips


A person who wants travel coordinated with a broader set of personal tasks


## How do Navan Edge and Muse book work trips?


Start with a realistic prompt: “I need to be in Austin by 3 p.m. Tuesday, I prefer a nonstop afternoon flight, I want a quiet hotel near X convention center, and I need dinner for four at 7:30 with vegan options near the hotel.”


Navan Edge can handle that as one travel request. It uses real-time travel inventory for flights and hotels, and restaurant discovery and reservations into the same chat. Your stated preferences, booking history, itinerary, and connected loyalty programs can shape the options. You review the choices and confirm before any booking moves forward.\[5\]\[6\]\[9\]


Muse can treat the prompt as a multi-step project. For flights, its Duffel connection searches live inventory across more than 500 airlines and supports booking and trip management. In Skift’s September 9 hands-on test, Muse used its browser to search consumer travel sites for hotel options. Restaurant research and reservations fit Muse’s broader ability to browse and act with approval.\[1\]\[3\]\[4\]


## Which one works better for frequent business travel?


The second trip you take with any platform can reveal more than the first. Imagine that Austin becomes a monthly route. You prefer a 4 p.m. departure, an aisle seat near the front, a hotel with an early-opening gym, and dinner within walking distance of the client’s office.


Navan Edge can use preferences shared in chat, booking history, and connected loyalty programs to tailor future flight, hotel, and restaurant options. That is where a dedicated AI assistant for business travel becomes valuable — you can tell it “book my usual trip to Austin” for example.\[5\]\[6\]\[7\]


Muse brings a different kind of continuity to repeat travel. As a general-purpose agent, it can support the wider set of tasks around a client visit, including email, calendar events, web research, forms, purchases, and travel planning.\[2\]\[4\]


## How does each assistant handle travel loyalty?


Navan Edge gives loyalty a dedicated place in the travel experience. Its Loyalty Wallet can show supported points and miles, and connected programs can also influence recommendations, which helps when two flight options contribute differently to an airline goal.


For travelers balancing several accounts, a single view of multiple loyalty programs can make status progress part of the booking decision.\[7\] You can also earn 5% Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel stays booked through the Navan Edge app.


As of October 6, 2026, Muse’s public product information lists no dedicated travel-rewards program, loyalty dashboard, balance tracking, tier-progress view, or loyalty-aware travel recommendations. Its general memory can retain personal details, but it is not presented as a travel loyalty feature.\[2\]\[3\]\[4\]


For someone planning a year of frequent work trips, that difference can determine whether loyalty is simply an instruction in the prompt or a built-in part of each booking decision .


## How do Navan Edge and Muse handle changes to your trip?


Business trips often evolve before or during the journey. Clear approvals and responsive service help travelers adapt while staying in control.


Tell Navan Edge what happened or what you need and it can manage the request in the same conversation as the original booking. If the situation calls for human judgment, a travel expert is available 24/7 to join the chat with the full trip context, so you don’t have to repeat the details or start over. If this conversation is happening on the road, that level of efficiency is really valuable. Before any booking, change, or cancellation goes through, Navan Edge asks for your explicit approval.\[5\]\[6\]


Muse can continue a task after you close the app and return when it needs input or approval. Within the live flight integration, Duffel validates fares and supports cancellations and disruption handling. Duffel also provides 24/7 access to travel experts for that flight-booking path.\[2\]\[3\]\[4\]


## Navan Edge or Muse for work travel: What’s the verdict?


The verdict goes beyond a list of travel features — Navan Edge draws on the infrastructure that Navan has spent more than a decade building for business travel. Behind the conversation are purpose-built AI, global real-time inventory, supplier connectivity, servicing operations, and travel expertise.\[6\]\[10\]


The depth of the platform becomes more valuable with every trip. Navan Edge can connect flight, hotel, and restaurant options with the preferences that matter to you, booking history, and connected loyalty programs that can make frequent business trips more comfortable and enjoyable. Supported loyalty points, miles, and status progress are visible and can inform recommendations, so each booking is optimized for both your schedule and rewards.


When a request calls for more judgment, a human travel expert can enter the existing conversation with full context. AI, inventory, loyalty context, service, and human expertise reinforce one another in one experience, and that is why we believe Navan Edge is the stronger choice for frequent business travel. Muse is a broad personal agent with strong travel capabilities. Navan Edge, however, is a personal assistant built specifically for business travelers and the trips they actually take.
